title: So Small
text: So Small. I bought this to put on my daughters' desk chair and it doesn't cover it it's really small!! I would say it would fit the top of a stool, that's how small it is. It's cute, n alil cozy it's like stuff animal hair. I was going to send it back but my daughter said she wanted to keep it.
